sections.title: Golden Bugs
sections.note: 12 species, a male and a female of each. Both of a pair live in the same area; they glow and chime, and show up best at night.

items.name: Male Beetle
items.area: Hyrule Field, Faron Province
items.howTo: From the Faron Woods exit, follow the path north and veer slightly west where the ground rises: the beetle is on the trunk of a tree there.

items.name: Female Beetle
items.area: Hyrule Field, Faron Province, northeast corner
items.howTo: On a tree trunk on a high, unreachable ledge at the northeast corner of the field. Walk the path north to south so you can see the north side of the trunk, then pull it down with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Ant
items.area: Kakariko Graveyard
items.howTo: On the ground by the tree in the northeast part of the graveyard.

items.name: Female Ant
items.area: Kakariko Village, empty house
items.howTo: On the floor of the boarded-up houses along the east side of the village, the third one (the one you can enter), next to Barnes Bombs.

items.name: Female Pill Bug
items.area: Kakariko Gorge, southeast
items.howTo: In the southeast part of Kakariko Gorge there are four trees; the bug is by the second-southernmost one and may crawl into the tall grass. Listen for its chime.

items.name: Male Pill Bug
items.area: Kakariko Gorge, by the bridge
items.howTo: Cross the wooden bridge over Kakariko Gorge toward Kakariko and turn right: it is in the open where the fence meets the cliff.

items.name: Female Grasshopper
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Hopping around in the open in the northwest part of the field north of Kakariko. Leevers keep surfacing here.

items.name: Male Grasshopper
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Kakariko Village
items.howTo: In the south-central part of the same field, just west of the short rock wall (a vertical line on the map). It is fast; the Gale Boomerang helps.

items.name: Male Phasmid
items.area: Bridge of Eldin, south end
items.howTo: As you reach the bridge from the south, it is high on the right-hand pillar of the gateway. Pull it down with the Gale Boomerang or Clawshot.

items.name: Female Phasmid
items.area: Bridge of Eldin, north end
items.howTo: Cross to the north end of the bridge, turn right and look up at the high ledge. Creep to the edge and snag it with the Gale Boomerang, or Clawshot up to the ledge.

items.name: Female Ladybug
items.area: Hyrule Field south of Castle Town
items.howTo: Leave Castle Town by the south gate, cross the bridge and go down the steps on the right: it is on the middle of three trees beside the pool. It flies off when approached, so chase it.

items.name: Male Ladybug
items.area: Hyrule Field south of Castle Town
items.howTo: On the east side of the same field, on or around the big stone pillar (the tower crows circle) among the flowers.

items.name: Male Butterfly
items.area: Hyrule Field west of Castle Town
items.howTo: Follow the road south of Castle Town's west gate to a patch of pink flowers; the butterfly flutters around them.
items.notes: On Wii (and HD Hero Mode) both butterflies are east of Castle Town.

items.name: Female Butterfly
items.area: Hyrule Field west of Castle Town, high ledge
items.howTo: On the high ledge just north of the road to the Great Bridge of Hylia, flying around flowers. Get close enough below to hit it with the Gale Boomerang, or Clawshot up to the ledge.

items.name: Female Mantis
items.area: Great Bridge of Hylia field
items.howTo: Coming from the south, cross the small wooden bridge and look high on the rock wall to the left, under the overhang. Pull it down with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Mantis
items.area: Great Bridge of Hylia, north end
items.howTo: Under the arch at the north end of the bridge; it flits in and out of the pillars, so wait if you don't see it. Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Stag Beetle
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town
items.howTo: Enter the north field and follow the path to the fork: it is on the lone tree stump straight ahead, west of the river from Zora's Domain.

items.name: Female Stag Beetle
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, mountain path
items.howTo: Climb the mountain path at the north of the field and keep to the lower path at the fork until an opening with a bombable boulder: the bug is on the wall above it. Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Dragonfly
items.area: Zora's Domain, waterfall basin
items.howTo: In the basin at the bottom of the Zora's Domain waterfall, climb up to the dry ground on the east side; it hovers near some boxes.

items.name: Female Dragonfly
items.area: Upper Zora's River, Iza's Boat Rental
items.howTo: Hovering over the water in front of Iza's boat rental. Stand at the water's edge and pull it in with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Snail
items.area: Sacred Grove
items.howTo: Near the guardian statues, take the left of the two openings, turn around and look up: the snail is high on the wall or ceiling. Pull it down with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Male Dayfly
items.area: Gerudo Desert, south-central
items.howTo: Out in the open in the south-central desert, just northeast of a large rock and south of the wooden gates you can ram with a boar. It shows up best at night.

items.name: Female Dayfly
items.area: Gerudo Desert, trenches north of the statue ruin
items.howTo: West of the male, find the ruin with a statue and a chest on a pillar. Of the trenches just north of it, the bug is in the northern one, on the wall.

items.name: Female Snail
items.area: Sacred Grove: Temple of Time entrance hall
items.howTo: Inside the Temple of Time, go down the entrance stairs and U-turn to the right: it is on the wall beside the steps. Gale Boomerang.
items.notes: The last bug you can reach; the temple only opens on the second visit to the Sacred Grove.

sections.title: Agitha's rewards
sections.note: Agitha's Castle, south Castle Town. Each bug after the first earns 50 Rupees (Purple), or 100 (Orange) when it completes a pair.

items.name: First Golden Bug
items.area: Agitha's Castle, Castle Town
items.howTo: Talk to Agitha in her castle off Castle Town's south road and hand her any Golden Bug.
items.notes: HD: the Wallet holds 500 and the Big Wallet 1,000. If you already got a wallet from the HD Cave of Shadows, she gives the next size up.

items.name: All 24 Golden Bugs
items.area: Agitha's Castle, Castle Town
items.howTo: Give Agitha the rest of the 24 bugs. Turning them in as you go pays 1,650 Rupees in all; don't hand one over when your wallet can't hold the payment.
items.notes: HD: if the Cave of Shadows already gave you a wallet, this is the Colossal Wallet (9,999). HD also gives a Miiverse Stamp of Agitha once she has half the bugs.
